- **Archive parent:** Condor - Analog EQ / Pre / Filter
- **Builder:** Chase Bliss Audio
- **Catalog type:** EQ / Filter / Overdrive
- **Identity:** All-analog EQ/preamp/filter pedal with digital control, switchable clean/overdrive operation and resonant filtering. [1][2]

- Switchable **clean / overdrive** operation.
- Parametric mid control from approximately **150 Hz to 5 kHz** with selectable Q.
- Bass boost/cut.
- Resonant **low-pass filter** with multiple resonance settings.
- Ramping/hold capability for filter-tremolo-style effects.
- True or buffered bypass selection. [1][2]

- Audio path is analog.
- Presets, MIDI, expression/CV and ramping are digitally controlled. [1]

- Exact production transistor/device part numbers are not established.

- Exact clipping-device part numbers are not established.

- Original Condor.
- Later **Condor HiFi** is a distinct redesigned model with higher internal headroom and OPA1662 architecture. [3]
- No numbered revision of the original Condor established.

Condor can act as EQ, preamp, overdrive and resonant filter. The sweepable mids and resonant low-pass filter permit both subtle tone shaping and extreme frequency-focused effects. [1][2]

- **Identity:** High
- **Analog/digital architecture:** High
- **Parametric EQ/filter system:** High
- **Condor HiFi distinction:** High
- **Exact semiconductor:** Unknown

Effects Database and MusicRadar's 2018 introduction were cross-checked. The sources support the analog EQ/pre/filter architecture and the documented clean/overdrive/filter functionality. [1][2]

1. Effects Database — Chase Bliss Condor: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/chasebliss/condor
2. MusicRadar — Chase Bliss Audio Condor, NAMM 2018: https://www.musicradar.com/news/namm-2018-chase-bliss-audio-introduces-condor-analog-eq-pre-filter-pedal
3. Effects Database — Condor HiFi: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/chasebliss/condor/hifi

- Exact-model photo status remains handled separately.
